notes: Security update: the app now checks who it is connecting to, and Direct mode warns you what it shows before you turn it on
Passwords are protected much more strongly: older accounts upgrade the next time you log in, and new passwords need 12 or more characters
Group invites now ask you first, and scanning a friend's QR code makes sure it really is them
Wake-up pings through Google are now off until you turn them on in Settings, under Calls
